Re: Account reference: ACC-696251

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. We understand that you are requesting validation of the debt.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with a written validation of the debt within 30 days of receiving your dispute. We will investigate the matter and provide you with the necessary documentation to support the debt.

We have reviewed the account information and confirmed that the original creditor was Lakeshore Utilities. The current balance on the account is $4,924.62. The charge-off date was March 8, 2021, and the last payment date was June 16, 2021.

We will provide you with a written validation of the debt, which will include the amount of the debt, the name of the creditor, and a statement that unless you dispute the validity of the debt, the debt will be assumed to be valid.

Please note that you have the right to dispute the validity of the debt, and we will investigate any disputes you may have. If you dispute the debt, we will verify the debt and provide you with the results of our investigation.

Sincerely,

[AGENCY NAME]
